VI.description: Simulated safety check - NOT a substitute for a BMS or hardware interlock. Priority: 1 E-Stop injection, 2 overvoltage, 3 overcurrent, 4 overtemperature (each: injection OR value above the DEMO limit), 5 output interlock (supply and load both on). On a fault: Fault latched with code, reason and first fault time, both simulated outputs OFF, both half-cycle flags cleared. While a fault is ALREADY latched the Status Message is left as it is, so command messages (Start blocked, reset refused) stay visible. Without a fault the data passes through unchanged (a latched fault is cleared only by Reset Fault in the main VI).
